messages.subject: fixed navbar to the top, when using navbarPage
parts:
Is it possible to fix the navbar to the top of the viewport, when scrolling, in a shiny app with the navbarPage function?
I am using a boostrap 2.3.2 theme ( theme = 'bootstrap.css' )

I have successfully added a fixed navbar at the bottom, using `footer`

footer=HTML("
